notes.title: Day and Night Cycle
notes.notes:
[h2]Hey Car Cleaners! 🚗✨[/h2]

In today’s devlog we’ve got another batch of new features coming to Car Cleaner Simulator!

We’re excited to introduce the day and night cycle, which not only changes the game’s visuals but also affects car wash opening hours, employee work shifts, and even customer behavior. This makes time management and planning essential, with each in-game day carrying its own unique atmosphere.

Check out how the environment changes as time passes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45544940/8851e93fe39be977e191dfefa44253e1c07f665e.gif[/img]

We’re also planning to add ways to earn money at night. As you expand your car wash, you’ll be able to install an automatic wash, which customers can use even while you’re resting after a busy day. Of course, nothing runs by itself - make sure you’ve stocked enough detergents for your night operations to work smoothly.

Stay tuned for more news coming soon on our Steam page and Discord channel!

[url=https://discord.gg/XUJbUBKw2q][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45544940/ac6ee872ce44139f01fa02c5dcfb4b72ebbf7dfc.gif[/img][/url]

PS. While waiting for Car Cleaner Simulator, get ready to meet a brand-new car coming to Car Dealer Simulator tomorrow!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2404880/Car_Dealer_Simulator/

notes.title: Car Traffic at the Car Wash
notes.notes:
[h2]Hey Car Cleaners! 🚗✨[/h2]

In today’s devlog, we’d like to share the latest news from development.

We’re currently working on the movement of customer cars at the car wash.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45544940/6588119d834eb61b2d40cfd8fd410a4329502a78.gif[/img]

As you expand your car wash, you’ll be able to add new stations for washing and detailing vehicles.

As you can see, customers will drive up to different stations to order specific services.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45544940/b034d31e633eee2d2c97f556cad90dbce91151ea.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45544940/a93b6c53aa2c5b13c2e2e5b13362b464f52650d0.gif[/img]

Once a customer parks their car in the washing or detailing zone, you’ll need to accept their order. The customer will then head to the waiting area and leave the car in your hands.

The speed and precision of your service - whether solo or in co-op - will affect the size of tips and the number of customers you can handle in a single day. This, in turn, impacts your overall profits and helps keep the waiting line free of impatient customers.

We’ll be back soon with more updates, so keep an eye on Steam and join our Discord!

[url=https://discord.gg/XUJbUBKw2q][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45544940/ac6ee872ce44139f01fa02c5dcfb4b72ebbf7dfc.gif[/img][/url]

PS. While waiting for more Car Cleaner Simulator news, get to know the town of Wingston Springs by playing Car Dealer Simulator. The Fuel Up Update was just released, and the game is now 10% off!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2404880/Car_Dealer_Simulator/

notes.title: The Waiting Room - A Key to Happy Customers
notes.notes:
[h2]Hey Car Cleaners! 🚗✨[/h2]

In today’s devlog, we’d like to show you an important building at the first level of your car wash lot - the customer waiting room:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45544940/f0a0d21dec19d69ee20e4e88a2c6c1f1f16b2fdf.png[/img]

This is a crucial spot because customer comfort while they wait for their car care service directly impacts tips. If they feel comfortable here, they’ll be more likely to come back.

Of course, we’re showing you the first level for now. In the future, we’ll reveal the upgrade possibilities for this building along with more upcoming features - as you can see, it’s not just a single room.

The look of the waiting room and how you serve customers while they wait will be an important part of the gameplay. That’s why our development efforts are focused not only on the mechanics of washing, detailing, and polishing cars, but also on engaging side tasks.

As you progress and unlock higher levels of the waiting room, we’ll share more details on how you’ll be able to take care not just of the cars, but also of their owners.

Leave a comment on our updates and join the community on Discord:

[url=https://discord.gg/XUJbUBKw2q][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45544940/ac6ee872ce44139f01fa02c5dcfb4b72ebbf7dfc.gif[/img][/url]

PS. While you’re waiting for Car Cleaner Simulator, you can play Car Dealer Simulator, which recently received a new car, Steam Cloud Save support, and expanded tablet functionality. In our latest devlog, there’s also a little teaser of the next big update.

notes.title: Washing Prototype and First Co-op Tests
notes.notes:
[h2]Hey Car Cleaners! 🚗✨[/h2]

In today’s devlog, we want to give you a quick look at two exciting things our team is currently working on:
the prototype of the cleaning mechanic and... replication!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45544940/df310a3f5e0e6f9298cdaf50f553d8a17a82dd28.gif[/img]

One of the key mechanics in the game will be thoroughly cleaning the interior of customers vehicles - this means spraying the right product and carefully wiping down all interior surfaces. It's all about attention to detail!

All mechanics are being developed with co-op mode in mind from the very beginning. In the GIF, you can see two different perspectives - one from the host player, and one from the joining player. That’s replication in action!

Thanks to replication, all your actions are synchronized across the session, making the experience smoother and more immersive. And of course, working together makes tasks faster, easier, and way more fun. Whether you’re tackling a dirty dashboard or scrubbing the seats, everything’s better with a teammate.

Stay tuned for more updates soon and don’t forget to bring a sponge! 🧽

Leave a comment on our updates and join the community on Discord:

notes.title: Dive into the Exciting World of Automotive Business!
notes.notes:
In today’s devlog, we’d like to tell you a bit more about Clever Emma and her family.

As you may remember from our previous devlog - she’s a true clean freak! When she was younger, she dedicated herself fully to her husband and kids. But thankfully, the kids eventually grew up. And while they might not be completely independent yet, Emma decided it was finally time to start her own business.

Since the whole family works in the automotive industry - and given her passion for cleanliness - there was only one logical choice: a car wash. For a while, things were running smoothly. Emma is far from just a homemaker—she turned out to be a great businesswoman. But with age, she’s grown a bit tired… and now she needs your help.

That’s where your journey in Car Cleaner Simulator begins.

Let’s meet her family:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45544940/87ecc28e692fe1d5962dfab9c9e56313dfa55ef1.png[/img]

Clever Emma’s husband is Little Sam.

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2404880/view/500579345320902668

If you’ve played Car Dealer Simulator, you’ve probably run into him. He’s always out and about, busy with something - or at least he says he is - and constantly on the phone. Fortunately, his role is mostly to introduce you to the game, and if you earn enough money, you’ll be able to buy the dealership from him. 😊

Their son, Lazy Luke, definitely takes after his dad.

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2242340/view/510712444576858140

His nickname speaks for itself. Lazy Luke is, well, lazy. He’s not cut out for business and would rather spend money than earn it. Little Sam gave him a few cars to kick off his rental company, but let’s be honest—without your help, he doesn’t stand a chance.

Leave a comment on our updates and join the community on Discord:

[url=https://discord.gg/XUJbUBKw2q][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45544940/ac6ee872ce44139f01fa02c5dcfb4b72ebbf7dfc.gif[/img][/url]

Working across these businesses - with the option to buy them and take full ownership - is your chance to build your automotive empire in Wingston Springs!

Want to try your hand at Car Rental Simulator? Expand your fleet, attract loyal customers, and grow your reputation - add it to your wishlist now:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2242340/Car_Rental_Simulator/

While waiting for Car Rental Simulator and Car Cleaner Simulator, don’t miss the first title in the series - Car Dealer Simulator! It’s now 10% off and includes awesome new features with the Junkyard Update:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2404880/Car_Dealer_Simulator/

notes.title: Meet Clever Emma!
notes.notes:
In today’s devlog, we’d like to introduce you to the owner of the Car Cleaner.

This woman’s got character - Clever Emma!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45544940/96afe3571edd7fbe393bd315a09083c6dc1f4433.png[/img]

On one hand, she’s a warm-hearted mom and a bit of a devoted wife, but when it comes to business, she’s a tough and demanding entrepreneur.

She loves cleanliness and order - that’s how she came up with the idea of running a car wash. Especially since the whole family is involved in the automotive industry. When the kids were little, she focused on the home, because her husband, Little Sam, was always busy and never around when she needed him. So all the household duties fell on her shoulders.

As the kids grew older, she started feeling a bit unneeded - and that’s when she came up with this business. She treats it like her baby. And even though she’s getting tired and would gladly sell the place, she won’t hand it over to just anyone.

That’s where your adventure begins!

Learn the ropes from Emma, and maybe - if you prove yourself solo or as a team - she’ll let you take over. Emma’s dream of a long, well-earned vacation has already started to grow in her mind. Whether it comes true is entirely up to you.

Stay tuned for more devlogs and don’t forget to share your thoughts and suggestions!

[url=https://discord.gg/XUJbUBKw2q][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45544940/ac6ee872ce44139f01fa02c5dcfb4b72ebbf7dfc.gif[/img][/url]

While you're waiting for Car Cleaner Simulator, check out Car Dealer Simulator - available now! You'll get to meet Little Sam, Clever Emma’s husband.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2404880/Car_Dealer_Simulator/

notes.title: Welcome to Car Cleaner Simulator!
notes.notes:
We’re excited to welcome you to the very first devlog for [i]Car Cleaner Simulator[/i].

Car Cleaner is set in the small town of Wingston Springs, right next to a gas station. The car wash is owned by Clever Emma. If you choose to work for her and gain enough experience, you'll eventually have the opportunity to buy out the business and run it your own way. The growth of your business will depend on the wide range of services you offer - from washing and cleaning to full car detailing. Of course, the most important aspect is customer service, so aside from upgrading your car wash, it’s also worth investing in the waiting area and even a car cosmetics shop.

Let’s open the gate - one you might recognize if you’ve already played [i]Car Dealer Simulator[/i]:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45544940/7acd8ece3150b769006b7871f5ea089f4fd4d6d0.gif[/img]

You can also invite your friends to join the fun, as the game will feature a co-op mode.

As you may have seen on our store page, the game is being developed by Hypnotic Ants and published by Garage Monkeys.

[url=https://discord.gg/XUJbUBKw2q][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45544940/ac6ee872ce44139f01fa02c5dcfb4b72ebbf7dfc.gif[/img][/url]

If you want to get to know the town better, we recommend playing the first game in the series - [i]Car Dealer Simulator[/i], which is already available. In [i]Car Dealer[/i], you’ll meet Little Sam - Clever Emma’s husband.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2404880/Car_Dealer_Simulator/
